statement: AMD's data-center GPU revenue is projected to grow sharply in 2026, with analyst consensus at ~+114% YoY to ~$15 billion and the Instinct MI400 series alone potentially ~$7.2 billion (~25% of AMD data-center sales).
why: An MI400 ramp plus Meta/OpenAI adoption underpins a large forecast increase in AMD merchant-GPU revenue; AMD's own Q2 2026 total-revenue guidance of ~$11.2 billion (+46% YoY) corroborates broad demand strength.

impact.mechanism: A large forecast ramp in AMD DC-GPU revenue implies rising merchant-GPU shipments and, via MI400's 432GB HBM4, additional HBM pull-through.

evidence.excerpt: AMD data-center GPU revenue is forecast to rise 114% year-on-year to ~$15 billion in 2026

reasoning: These are analyst-consensus forecasts explicitly labeled not AMD-official, extrapolating from the MI400 ramp and design wins, so they are treated as a hypothesis pending AMD's own disclosures at Advancing AI 2026.

confidence.basis: Analyst-consensus forecast from secondary trade coverage, not vendor-official guidance.
